captions.constructors: Route constructor performance at the {horizon}-day horizon over the balanced factorial grid ({runs} runs). Best value per column in bold.
captions.strategies: Mandatory-selection strategies at the {horizon}-day horizon, ordered by observed collection efficiency. Efficiency falls monotonically as the rule grows more conservative; overflow risk does not fall with it, being essentially flat across the three middle strategies.

captions.excluded: Runs excluded from all aggregate statistics as degenerate rather than merely poor.

notes.constructors: Means and medians over the scenarios that survive the integrity filter. Every constructor faced the identical demand realisation within each scenario and contributes the same {runs_per} runs: the scenario cells containing the degenerate runs of Table~\ref{{tab:excluded}} were dropped for all constructors, not only for the one that failed them, so no constructor is averaged over a subset that flatters it. Medians are reported alongside means because a single extreme scenario can move a mean substantially at this sample size.
notes.strategies: CF70/CF90 are Last-Minute critical-fill thresholds of 70\% and 90\%; SL1/SL2 are Service-Level projection horizons of one and two days. Medians are reported alongside means: removing one run in roughly ninety moved the Service-Level (SL2) mean overflow count from 9.3 to 1.4, so the means at this sample size are sensitive to individual scenarios.
notes.improvers: Pairing rather than averaging: each pair is the same constructor, strategy, region and demand realisation, differing only in improver. Win counts exclude ties, which are reported separately; overflow counts tie often because neither improver changes which bins were selected for collection.
notes.horizon: Only configurations on the 30-day Pareto front were re-run at 90 days, so the 90-day sample is conditioned on 30-day performance. Constructors are therefore compared against themselves across horizons and never against each other at 90 days.
notes.excluded: Within a scenario every constructor collects from the same waste realisation, so collected tonnage is comparable by construction. These runs fell more than {threshold}\% below their scenario median and did not complete; their overflow counts measure truncation, not policy behaviour.
